detail: initial acceleration 1.2132 m/s2 with added mass, 1.0515 m/s2 without

name: P12
title: current disturbance response
detail: The model has no ambient current. gz-sim-hydrodynamics-system accepts no flow input and the reference world never defined one, so there is nothing to measure. Adding a current is a model extension, deferred beyond M2.5.
